# Task 4 implementation report

Owner: progress_task4, 2026-10-10. Base `40b946fb20360f4151aa838ef58ba5bde5287162`; implementation `e8668544198effe1394110837c758884fc26247a`; acceptance/proof source `92b4625be07d59845d02df52cb6f89160e5b33e4`. Report created at 2026-10-10T10:01:38.982765+00:00. No subagents.

## Delivered composition and scope
Six canonical group regions have stable ids and mounted panels: Progress graph/work table (including the actual current run reason), Preparation budget/Agent editors, Problems actual failure/block/usage/requested-run facts plus exact run navigation, Results missing/not-produced explanation placeholder plus existing evidence navigation and retained Git/integration controls, Runs the single full run table and its unchanged retry/settlement controls, Technical skills/handoff/estimate/uncertain diagnostics. One mounted TaskDetail outside the panels keeps the explicitly opened task visible and its unfinished local input alive across region changes. Its section is focusable.

Stored draft defaults Preparation; ordinary active and review default Progress (review explicitly says goal review); done defaults Results even with no explanation. Explicit owner region overrides defaults. Dispatch aliases Preparation for ready/draft and Problems otherwise; Integration aliases Results. These are presentation decisions only. Existing start/stop/retry/recovery/continue/settlement/archive/integration guards and callbacks remain in their current owners. All tab/run navigation is client selection/focus, with zero command POST. Server DTO enum, routes, model, schema, result fetching, and command behavior are unchanged.

App passes its explicit request nonce through ControlPanel. Layout effects react only to explicit focus/nonce, never the arriving GroupView; manual region/focus/drafts remain stable through polling. Overview ordinary progress now uses a client-only progress target while queued start-review retains dispatch→Preparation. Live-owner GET and accepted identity/auth/epoch/scope/task/run checks remain untouched.

RequirementsPanel is unchanged under the controller's explicit minimal-composition ruling: its actual answers/draft/problem owner surfaces and App-owned draft ownership remain valid. Full Web includes requirements/requirementsApp/requirementsI18n/projectScopeDrafts/overviewApp owner and poll criteria; exact requested requirement ids and no group GET/no POST continue passing. TaskDetail changed only to add a focusable owned section; no editor/evidence/run action implementation changed. Settings implementation and global/project placement remain unchanged.

## Criteria and TDD distinction
Initial actual RED: task4-red / task4-red-compact, 9 missing region/default/selection/archived/member criteria, RC1. Task4-navigation-red, 2 distinct Overview progress/start owner criteria, RC1 because no tabs existed. Green2:11/11. These are feature REDs, not dependency/setup errors.

Real follow-up defect RED: task4-focus-red showed repeated same-target request failed to reopen Task a after manual close. Added nonce to the task-selection effect; green3 15/15. Its other two failures were fixture mistakes, explicitly separate: a settled-failed retry fixture lacked the required current allocation/settlement qualification (corrected to the existing eligible blocked failure); evidence row text was expected to contain run id despite existing task-based row presentation (changed to actual raw evidence). No business guard was changed.

Real simultaneous-state RED: task4-simultaneous-red failed the assertion that the current run's actual failure explanation was visible beside active/blocked task facts in Progress. The current run's existing RunReason now composes into the work row; task4-focused-green passed37/37.

Setup failures retained: green1/type1 were locale insertion syntax errors, not feature RED; type2 caught a nonliteral focus fixture and an invalid task status string (server status is blocked, not failed); type3 caught a test helper's boolean/void return annotation. All corrected with final root/Web typecheck RC0. Additional mounted integration draft and completed-results evidence criteria are supplemental proof criteria,21/21 green on existing production; their independent deletion faults subsequently fail. They are not misrepresented as pre-implementation TDD.

## Legacy presentation changes, with eligibility assertions retained
Before: legacy criteria assumed graph, budget, full run table, Git/integration, skills and dispatch were concurrently visible. After: those criteria explicitly request or navigate to the actual owner region, preserving positive and negative command payload, revision, permission, archive, retry source and server guard assertions.

- driverRetry, evidenceLink, feedbackReadability, settleUnknownUsage: explicit Runs target; failure text scoped to the real visible tabpanel so hidden mounted copies do not satisfy or duplicate text assertions. Original refusal/settlement dimensions, identity, role and guard assertions unchanged.
- handoffResume/stopBanner: explicit dispatch target (actual Preparation/Problems alias); unchanged start/stop/continuation/resume payload and refused-button assertions. handoffFailedRetry: Runs for actual retry/usage facts, then Problems for checkpoint/resume controls, preserving all lifecycle assertions.
- gitScheme/integrationScheme: Results for actual Git/post-confirm controls; Preparation for pre-confirm integration inside the existing BudgetEditor. Original owner/member and scheme/hash/refusal/PR-link assertions remain. Loop-plan Git tests navigate Progress to open their task.
- skillsPanel: explicit Technical target; original frozen/lock/provenance expectations unchanged.
- groupRefusal: navigate Problems before pause; refusal ordering uses the actual mounted Budget proposal DOM node because that check measures ordering, not concurrent visibility. Refusal persistence/clearing/authenticated command checks remain.
- projectFiltering: Results navigation before the existing Git workspace assertions; exact repository and latest-response guards remain.
- controlCommandRecovery: Runs navigation before D9 settlement; authenticated roles, retained command id, payload and lost-answer handling unchanged.
- loopSuggestionDraft: Progress to open task/unfinished plan text, Preparation to apply the existing suggestion; original refusal/base-version/POST/draft-preservation expectations unchanged.
- controlI18n: navigate Technical/Preparation/Runs/Problems for each existing visible heading/action assertion. Chinese command/label/role wording remains.
- overviewApp named `a task/run attention destination opens the requested task before focusing its problem region`: verifies the actual visible Task target-task common owner section rather than a hidden Progress row toggle. Exact problem focus/no POST assertions retained.
- archiveGroup named old `puts the archived banner before the graph, the graph before the work-items table, the table before runs, and runs before the budget editor` is replaced (controller/human-authorized hierarchy ruling) with `keeps the archived banner before the progress graph and table, with budget and runs in their own regions`. Banner/graph/table order remains; full Runs and Preparation ownership is measured under explicit selection. Archived action/editor checks now visit every region, retain the positive10-control minimum, and deduplicate the same mounted HTMLElement rather than command label (two Retry controls still count independently). No hidden control can satisfy archived-negative criteria.

Native run.py logs raw argv before execution and preserves stdout/stderr + RC; task4-run.py additionally writes cwd and source SHA before execution for later gates/proofs, then invokes run.py without exposing env.json. Early RED/iteration commands used run.py directly, with cwd recorded by tool-call workdir rather than a .cwd file: this is disclosed, not retroactively claimed as pre-execution cwd-file logging. The owned runner env supplies isolated HOME/XDG/TMPDIR/CCMEM data, fake agents, fixed existing provider pin; no actual user data/provider/config switch.

## Self-review and final-controller boundaries
Command rendering was moved by responsibility; callbacks/qualifications remain unchanged and have positive/negative full Web/root gates. Client-only target widening leaves web/server DTO exact parity intact. Common TaskDetail and mounted preparation/results forms retain local and App-owned drafts; explicit nonce restoration is covered independently. No dependencies, production runtime, schema, paid provider, main merge, push, branch/worktree deletion or unrelated settings fixes. Exact path staging excluded controller plan-self-review.md and node_modules.

Warnings retained: Web build's >500k chunk warning; root experimental SQLite warnings; retry fault fixture's repository-unavailable line; Git's automatic committer identity notice. They were not silenced or changed. Real HTTP desktop/390px/short-height geometry, aggregate fullRoot/pin/leak and independent review are controller final gates, not claimed by these jsdom/component checks. The existing ControlGroupView is large; composition kept command ownership local to minimize guard drift. Results placeholder is deliberately temporary; Results Task5 owns actual report integration.

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1d3fce1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web/src/GroupDetailRegions.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+/** All owner panels remain mounted: navigation never throws away unfinished input. */
+import type { JSX, ReactNode } from "react";
+import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
+import { DETAIL_REGIONS, type DetailRegion } from "./detailRegion.js";
+import { overviewRegionId } from "./overviewNavigation.js";
+export function GroupDetailRegions(props: { groupId: string; selected: DetailRegion; onSelect: (region: DetailRegion) => void; regions: Record<DetailRegion, ReactNode> }): JSX.Element {
+ const { t } = useTranslation();
+ return <>
+  <div role="tablist" aria-label={t("detail.regions")} className="detail-region-tabs">
+   {DETAIL_REGIONS.map(region => <button key={region} type="button" role="tab" id={`${overviewRegionId("group", props.groupId, region)}-tab`} aria-controls={overviewRegionId("group", props.groupId, region)} aria-selected={props.selected === region} onClick={() => props.onSelect(region)}>{t(`detail.${region}`)}</button>)}
+  </div>
+  {DETAIL_REGIONS.map(region => <div key={region} role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby={`${overviewRegionId("group", props.groupId, region)}-tab`} id={overviewRegionId("group", props.groupId, region)} tabIndex={-1} data-overview-region={region} hidden={props.selected !== region}>{props.regions[region]}</div>)}
+ </>;
+}

diff --git a/web/src/detailRegion.ts b/web/src/detailRegion.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3159b2d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web/src/detailRegion.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+/** Presentation only: stored state chooses the first region; explicit owner navigation wins. */
+import type { GroupViewV1 } from "./controlTypes.js";
+import type { GroupRegion } from "./overviewNavigation.js";
+export const DETAIL_REGIONS = ["progress", "preparation", "problem", "results", "runs", "technical"] as const;
+export type DetailRegion = typeof DETAIL_REGIONS[number];
+export function defaultDetailRegion(view: GroupViewV1): DetailRegion {
+  if (view.summary.state === "done") return "results";
+  if (view.summary.state === "draft") return "preparation";
+  return "progress";
+}
+export function dispatchDetailRegion(view: GroupViewV1): DetailRegion {
+  return view.summary.state === "draft" || view.summary.state === "ready" ? "preparation" : "problem";
+}
+export function focusedDetailRegion(view: GroupViewV1, region: GroupRegion): DetailRegion {
+  if (region === "dispatch") return dispatchDetailRegion(view);
+  if (region === "integration") return "results";
+  return region;
+}
+export const runRegionId = (groupId: string, runId: string): string => `detail-run-${encodeURIComponent(groupId)}-${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`;

+// @vitest-environment jsdom
+import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, within, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
+import { afterEach, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { App } from "../src/App.js";
+import { ALPHA, groupSummary, installFakePanel, planGroupView } from "./fixtures/twoProjects.js";
+afterEach(()=>{cleanup();window.localStorage.clear();window.sessionStorage.clear();vi.restoreAllMocks();window.location.hash="";});
+it.each(["progress", "start"] as const)("Overview %s opens its distinct owner region without commands", async(kind)=>{
+ window.location.hash="";const panel=installFakePanel();const group=groupSummary("g",ALPHA,{state:"ready"});panel.summary.groups=[group];panel.groupViews.g=planGroupView(group);
+ const base=globalThis.fetch;globalThis.fetch=(async(input,init)=>String(input)==="/api/control/overview"?new Response(JSON.stringify({schema:"orca-control-overview-v1",epoch:"epoch-a",changeSeq:1,groups:[group],steps:[{key:"start",groupId:"g",repoId:ALPHA,taskId:null,runId:null,kind:"start-review",reason:"start-review",ownerRequired:false,destination:{kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"dispatch",taskId:null,runId:null}}],issues:[]})):base(input,init)) as typeof fetch;
+ render(<App/>);const overview=screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Overview"});
+ const region=within(overview).getByRole("region",{name:kind==="progress"?"Progress":"Needs your attention"});
+ fireEvent.click(await within(region).findByRole("button"));await screen.findByRole("region",{name:"Control group g"});
+ await waitFor(()=>expect(screen.getByRole("tab",{selected:true}).textContent).toBe(kind==="progress"?"Progress":"Preparation"));
+ expect(panel.requests).toContain("GET /api/control/groups/g");expect(panel.posts).toHaveLength(0);
+ expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute("data-overview-region")).toBe(kind==="progress"?"progress":"dispatch");
+});

+// @vitest-environment jsdom
+/** Task4: region defaults are presentation; eligibility remains with existing controls. */
+import { cleanup, fireEvent, render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";

+afterEach(cleanup);
+const mount = (value: GroupViewV1, focus?: import("../src/ControlGroupView.js").ControlGroupViewProps["focus"]) => render(<ControlGroupView view={value} focus={focus} config={config} uncertain={[]} drafts={{}} onDraft={vi.fn()} onCommand={vi.fn()} />);
+const select = (name: string) => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("tab", { name }));
+const selected = () => screen.getByRole("tab", { selected: true }).textContent;

+ const value = view([]); value.summary.state = state; mount(value);

+ if (state === "done") expect(screen.getByRole("tabpanel").textContent).toContain("explanation is missing");
+});
+it("explicit problem owner overrides default and a poll preserves manual region and focus", () => {

+ const tab=screen.getByRole("tab",{name:"Technical details"}); tab.focus();
+ app.rerender(<ControlGroupView view={{...value,summary:{...value.summary,state:"done"},changeSeq:5}} focus={focus} config={config} uncertain={[]} drafts={{}} onDraft={vi.fn()} onCommand={vi.fn()} />);
+ expect(selected()).toBe("Technical details"); expect(document.activeElement).toBe(tab);
+});
+it("task form input stays mounted across regions and polls", () => {
+ const value=view([workItem({taskId:"a"})]); const app=mount(value);
+ fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button",{name:"a"})[0]!);
+ const input=screen.getByRole("textbox",{name:"Custom label"}) as HTMLInputElement;
+ fireEvent.change(input,{target:{value:"keep my unfinished text"}}); select("Preparation"); select("Progress");
+ app.rerender(<ControlGroupView view={{...value,changeSeq:5}} config={config} uncertain={[]} drafts={{}} onDraft={vi.fn()} onCommand={vi.fn()} />);
+ expect((screen.getByRole("textbox",{name:"Custom label"}) as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe("keep my unfinished text");
+});
+it("active and failed task facts remain visible together without inferring success", () => {
+ const failed=run({runId:"failed",taskId:"b",state:"settled-failed",outcome:"failed",stopReason:"Error: codex-event-error"});
+ mount(view([workItem({taskId:"a",status:"active"}),workItem({taskId:"b",status:"blocked",currentRunId:"failed",lineageRunIds:["failed"]})],[failed]));
+ const panel=screen.getByRole("tabpanel");expect(panel.textContent).toContain("active");expect(panel.textContent).toContain("blocked");expect(within(panel).getByText(/reported an error/)).toBeTruthy();
+ select("Problems");expect(screen.getByRole("tabpanel").textContent).toContain("settled-failed");
+});
+it("every region of an archived group remains read-only with unarchive available", () => {
+ const value=view([workItem({taskId:"a",labels:["bug"]})]);value.summary.archived=true; mount(value);
+ for(const name of ["Progress","Preparation","Problems","Results","Runs and evidence","Technical details"]){
+  select(name); expect(screen.queryAllByRole("button",{name:/^(Start|Pause dispatch|Handoff stop|Resume|Continue|Retry|Set limit|Save|Confirm|Archive group)/})).toHaveLength(0);
+  expect(screen.queryAllByRole("textbox").filter(x=>!(x as HTMLInputElement).readOnly)).toHaveLength(0);
+ }
+ expect(screen.getByRole("button",{name:"Unarchive"})).toBeTruthy();
+});
+it("member preparation preserves the owner-only limit restriction", () => {
+ render(<AccountContext.Provider value={{user:{id:"m",name:"Member",roles:["member"],mustChangePassword:false},expiresAt:0,sessionDays:1}}><ControlGroupView view={view([])} config={config} uncertain={[]} drafts={{}} onDraft={vi.fn()} onCommand={vi.fn()} /></AccountContext.Provider>);
+ select("Preparation"); expect(screen.queryByRole("button",{name:"Set limit"})).toBeNull();expect(screen.getByText("Only an owner can change the group limit.")).toBeTruthy();
+});
+
+it("repeated explicit navigation reopens the requested region and task after manual changes", () => {
+ const value=view([workItem({taskId:"a"})]);const focus={kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"problem",taskId:"a",runId:null} as const;
+ const props={view:value,focus,config,uncertain:[],drafts:{},onDraft:vi.fn(),onCommand:vi.fn()};
+ const app=render(<ControlGroupView {...props} focusRequest={1}/>);select("Progress");fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button",{name:"a"})[0]!);
+ app.rerender(<ControlGroupView {...props} focusRequest={2}/>);
+ expect(selected()).toBe("Problems");expect(screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Task a"})).toBeTruthy();
+});
+it("problem run navigation opens and focuses the exact existing run controls without sending commands", () => {
+ const failed=run({runId:"failed",taskId:"b",state:"blocked",outcome:"failed"});const onCommand=vi.fn();
+ render(<ControlGroupView view={view([workItem({taskId:"b",status:"blocked",currentRunId:"failed",lineageRunIds:["failed"]})],[failed])} focus={{kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"problem",taskId:null,runId:"failed"}} config={config} uncertain={[]} drafts={{}} onDraft={vi.fn()} onCommand={onCommand}/>);
+ fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button",{name:"Open run controls and evidence · failed"}));
+ expect(selected()).toBe("Runs and evidence");expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute("data-run-id")).toBe("failed");expect(screen.getByRole("button",{name:"Retry task b"})).toBeTruthy();expect(onCommand).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+});
+it("integration alias shows retained Git controls inside Results", () => {
+ mount(view([]),{kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"integration",taskId:null,runId:null});
+ expect(selected()).toBe("Results");expect(screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Git"})).toBeTruthy();expect(screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Integration of this group"})).toBeTruthy();
+});
+it("hidden panels are inaccessible while technical evidence remains navigable", () => {
+ mount(view([workItem({taskId:"a"})],[run({runId:"evidence-run",evidenceIds:["raw-evidence"]})]));
+ expect(screen.queryByRole("region",{name:"Budget proposal"})).toBeNull();
+ for(const panel of document.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]'))expect((panel as HTMLElement).hidden).toBe(panel.getAttribute("data-overview-region")!=="progress");
+ select("Runs and evidence");expect(screen.getByRole("tabpanel").textContent).toContain("raw-evidence");
+});
+
+it("Results before completion honestly says not produced and keeps evidence reachable", () => {
+ mount(view([]));select("Results");expect(screen.getByRole("status").textContent).toContain("has not been produced");
+});
+it("a focus belonging to another owner does not override this group's stored default or task", () => {
+ mount(view([workItem({taskId:"a"})]),{kind:"group",groupId:"other",region:"results",taskId:"a",runId:null});
+ expect(selected()).toBe("Progress");expect(screen.queryByRole("region",{name:"Task a"})).toBeNull();
+});
+it("all real failure, driver block, unsettled-usage and requested run facts have exact navigation", () => {
+ const failed=run({runId:"f",outcome:"failed",state:"settled-recoverable"});const blocked=run({runId:"b",state:"blocked",blockedReason:"driver-block"});const unknown=run({runId:"u",unknownUsageSettlement:{generation:1,highWater:1,remaining:{work:run({}).remaining,handoff:run({}).remaining},allowed:false,refusalReason:"proof-required"}});const requested=run({runId:"r"});const ordinary=run({runId:"o"});
+ mount(view([], [failed,blocked,unknown,requested,ordinary]),{kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"problem",taskId:null,runId:"r"});
+ for(const id of ["f","b","u","r"])expect(screen.getByRole("button",{name:"Open run controls and evidence · "+id})).toBeTruthy();
+ expect(screen.queryByRole("button",{name:"Open run controls and evidence · o"})).toBeNull();
+});
+it("ControlPanel forwards an explicit repeated owner request independently of polls", async () => {
+ const {ControlPanel}=await import("../src/ControlPanel.js");const value=view([]);const focus={kind:"group",groupId:"g",region:"problem",taskId:null,runId:null} as const;
+ const props={focus,view:value,config,summary:{schema:"orca-control-summary-v1" as const,epoch:"epoch-a",changeSeq:4,resetRequired:false,dispatchBlocked:false,groups:[value.summary]},recovery:{schema:"orca-control-recovery-v1" as const,epoch:"epoch-a",dispatchBlocked:false,blockers:[]},groups:{g:value},selected:"g",drafts:{},uncertain:[],refusal:null,refetchRequired:false,onSelect:vi.fn(),onDraft:vi.fn(),onCommand:vi.fn()};
+ const app=render(<ControlPanel {...props} focusRequest={1}/>);select("Results");app.rerender(<ControlPanel {...props} focusRequest={2}/>);expect(selected()).toBe("Problems");
+});
+
+it("unsaved integration form stays mounted through region changes", () => {
+ mount(view([]));select("Results");const region=screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Integration of this group"});
+ fireEvent.change(within(region).getByRole("combobox",{name:"Delivery"}),{target:{value:"local"}});
+ fireEvent.change(within(region).getByRole("textbox",{name:"Target branch"}),{target:{value:"my unfinished target"}});
+ select("Progress");select("Results");expect((within(screen.getByRole("region",{name:"Integration of this group"})).getByRole("textbox",{name:"Target branch"}) as HTMLInputElement).value).toBe("my unfinished target");
+});

+ const value=view([],[run({runId:"result-run",state:"settled-recoverable"})]);value.summary.state="done";mount(value);
+ expect(screen.getByRole("status").textContent).toContain("explanation is missing");

+ expect(screen.getByRole("button",{name:"evidence"})).toBeTruthy();
+});
